strings.en: {count, plural, =1{1 short clip hidden} other{{count} short clips hidden}}
strings.description: Quiet line at the end of a day on the Home list: how many very short or noise-only recordings Omi folded away from that day. {count} is a whole number.
Tappable word after the hidden-clips count on Home; reveals the folded short recordings in place.

strings.en: {count, plural, =1{Hide 1 short clip} other{Hide {count} short clips}}
strings.description: Tappable line at the end of a day on Home after the user revealed the short recordings; folds them away again. {count} is a whole number.
